Asha: Quick post-QBR sync — capturing exec asks and next steps. Need owners for slides, onboarding gaps, and renewal risk analysis. TL;DR: Slides edits by Tue EOD, onboarding gaps triage by Fri noon, renewal deep-dive by Mon. Slides link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBRslides
Miguel: Got it. Main asks: clearer uptime metrics + cost KPIs. I'll take the metrics slide. When's the dry run?
Priya: I'll own onboarding gaps. Preliminary list: 1) SSO setup stalled, 2) sample data ingestion missing, 3) no customer training scheduled. I'll upload tracking sheet shortly.
Ben: I'll lead renewal risk analysis. Need usage trends + CSAT. @Miguel can you share cost/usage snapshot?
Miguel: Uploading cost snapshot: https://drive.google.com/open?id=cost_snapshot.csv :file_folder:
Asha: Owners assigned — Miguel (metrics + latency charts), Priya (onboarding tracker), Ben (renewal framework), Asha (exec follow-up email). Deadlines above. Please add Jira ticket IDs when created.
ops-bot: Reminder set — daily follow-ups posted to #customer-success at 9:00am until tasks are closed. :bell:
Priya: Quick ask — customer requested a hands-on demo. Can we shift the demo to Thu 11am PST?
Asha: That works for me. @Ben can you confirm exec invite list?
Ben: Confirmed — exec invite approved. I'll draft talking points and share by Tue.
Miguel: Also planning a before/after for caching improvements — will add 95th percentile latency chart to slides.
Priya: Uploaded onboarding tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1onboardtracker — I've added owners next to each gap.
Asha: Perfect. I'll send calendar invites and open Jira tickets tonight. Who wants to co-author the follow-up email? @Priya?
Priya: Happy to co-author. :thumbsup:
Asha: Thanks everyone — closing thread. I'll post the slide link update when edits are done.
